<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                                 &= \dfrac {120} {4} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {4 \times 30} {4} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 30} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                 &= 30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

a           &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 2 \times 1 \cancel{0}}{\cancel{3} \times 1 \cancel{0} \times 10} \\\\
a           &= \dfrac{2}{10} \\\\
a           &=0.2
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Circle the number below which is not a factor of $60$?

$15 \quad 120 \quad 60$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Circle the number below which is not a factor of $60$?
<emptyline>
$15 \quad 120 \quad 60$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$15$ is a factor of $60$ (since $60 \div 15 = 4$)

$60$ is a factor of $60$ (since $60 \div 60 = 1$)

$120$ is **not** a factor of $60$ (since $60 \div 120$ is not a whole number)
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$120$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write down all the numbers between $50$ and $150$ that have an odd number of factors?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
</code></pre>

<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: We know that a number has an odd number of factors only if it is a perfect square.
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's list all the perfect squares between $50$ and $150$.

| Number | Calculation | Result |
|:------:|:-----------:|:-------:|
| $8$    | $8 \times 8$   | $64 < 150$ |
| $9$    | $9 \times 9$   | $81 < 150$ |
| $10$   | $10 \times 10$ | $100 < 150$ |
| $11$   | $11 \times 11$ | $121 < 150$ |
| $12$   | $12 \times 12$ | $144 < 150$ |
| $\red{13}$   | $\red{13 \times 13}$ | $\red{169 > 150}$ |

From the table above, all the perfect squares that are less than $150$ and greater than $50$ are $64, \ 81, \ 100, \ 121,$ and $144$.
</div>

-  $3.33$
-  $33.3$
-  $93.7$

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
82 - 27  &= 5 \times a \\\\
5a       &= 82 - 27 \\\\
5a       &= 55 \\\\
a        &= \dfrac {55} {5} \\\\
a        &= \dfrac {5 \times 11} {5} \\\\
a        &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 11} {\cancel {5} } \\\\
a        &= 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $\ \text{mm}$ is three-fifths of a $\ \text{metre}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $\ \text{mm}$ is three-fifths of a $\ \text{metre}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{3}{5} \ \text{m} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3}{5} \times 1000 \ \text{mm} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 1000} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times 5 \times 200}{5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{3 \times \cancel{5} \times 200}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 200 \\\\
&= 600 \ \text{mm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $(9999 - 999 + 99 - 9) \div 9$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $(9999 - 999 + 99 - 9) \div 9$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (9999 - 999 + 99 - 9) \div 9 \\\\
&= 9090 \div 9 \\\\
&= \dfrac {9090}{9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1010 \times 9}{9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {1010 \times \cancel{9}}{\cancel{9}} \\\\
&= 1010
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

What is the value of $20 \%$ of $(60)^{2}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the value of $20 \%$ of $(60)^{2}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 20 \% \text { of } (60)^{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{20}{100} \times 60 \times 60 \\\\
&= \dfrac{20 \times 60 \times 60}{100}  \\\\
&= \dfrac{20 \times 6\cancel{0} \times 6\cancel{0}}{1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}}  \\\\
&= 20 \times 6 \times 6 \\\\
&= 720
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Divide $(2018 - 20 + 18)$ by $8$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Divide $(2018 - 20 + 18)$ by $8$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (2018 - 20 + 18) \div 8 \\\\
&= 2016 \div 8 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2016}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{252 \times 8}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{252 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 252
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Divide $(2018 - 20 + 18)$ by $8$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Divide $(2018 - 20 + 18)$ by $8$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= (2018 - 20 + 18) \div 8 \\\\
&= 2016 \div 8 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2016}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{252 \times 8}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{252 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 252
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

To get the smallest number, choose the smallest number as
the numerator and the biggest number as the denominator.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number}   &= \dfrac {8} {16} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {8} {8 \times 2} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {\cancel {8}} {\cancel {8} \times 2} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

What division gives the result closest to $1?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What division gives the result closest to $1?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Divide each pair of numbers and compare how close each result is to $1$.

| Division          | Value        | Difference |
|:-----------------:|:------------:|:--------------------------------:|
| $8 \div 10$       | $0.8$        | $\lvert 1 - 0.8 \rvert = 0.2$ |
| $8 \div 12$       | $\approx 0.67$ | $\lvert 1 - 0.67 \rvert \approx 0.33$ |
| $8 \div 16$       | $0.5$        | $\lvert 1 - 0.5 \rvert = 0.5$ |
| $10 \div 8$       | $1.25$       | $\lvert 1 - 1.25 \rvert = 0.25$ |
| $10 \div 12$      | $\approx 0.83$ | $\lvert 1 - 0.83 \rvert \approx 0.17$ |
| $10 \div 16$      | $0.625$      | $\lvert 1 - 0.625 \rvert = 0.375$ |
| $12 \div 8$       | $1.5$        | $\lvert 1 - 1.5 \rvert = 0.5$ |
| $12 \div 10$      | $1.2$        | $\lvert 1 - 1.2 \rvert = 0.2$ |
| $12 \div 16$      | $0.75$       | $\lvert 1 - 0.75 \rvert = 0.25$ |
| $16 \div 8$       | $2$          | $\lvert 1 - 2 \rvert = 1$ |
| $16 \div 10$      | $1.6$        | $\lvert 1 - 1.6 \rvert = 0.6$ |
| $16 \div 12$      | $\approx 1.33$ | $\lvert 1 - 1.33 \rvert \approx 0.33$ |

Closest number $= 0.83 = \dfrac {10} {12}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {10} {12}$

**Working**

 To be close to $4000$, the number should start with $3$ (approaching from below) or $4$ (approaching from above).

For the number closest to $4000$ starting with $3$, we want the largest possible value, so $3941$. The difference is $4000 - 3941 = 59$.

For the number closest to $4000$ starting with $4$, we want the smallest possible value, so $4139$. The difference is $4139 - 4000 = 139$.

$59$ is smaller than $139$, so $3941$ is the nearest.

Answer $= 3941$
</div>

**Question**

What is $4 - ((4 + 4) \div 4)?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of the following is the best estimate for the length of a bus?

- $0.2\ \text{km}$ 
- $2\ \text{m}$ 
- $20\ \text{cm}$ 
- $20 000\ \text{mm}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which of the following is the best estimate for the length of a bus?
<emptyline>
- $0.2\ \text{km}$ 
- $2\ \text{m}$ 
- $20\ \text{cm}$ 
- $20 000\ \text{mm}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's convert all options to meters to compare with a typical bus length (approximately $10$ to $15 \ \text{m}$ )

|  **Options** |         **in $\text{m}$**         | **Comment**                                             |
| :-----------------: | :-------------------------------------: | :------------------------------------------------------ |
|   $0.2\ \text{km}$  |    $0.2 \times 1000 = 200\ \text{m}$    | Too long for a bus                                  |
|    $2\ \text{m}$    |              $2\ \text{m}$              | Short (size of a small car)                    |
|   $20\ \text{cm}$   |    $\dfrac{20}{100} = 0.2\ \text{m}$    | Much too short (length of a ruler)                      |
| $20000\ \text{mm}$ | $\dfrac{20000}{1000} = 20\ \text{m}$ | Best estimate  |

Answer $= 20000 \ \text{mm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>D</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20000 \ \text{mm}$

</div>
</div>

There are $10 \ \text{millimetres}$ in a centimetre and $100 \ \text{centimetres}$ in a metre.

How many millimetres are there in $25.1 \ \text{metres}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$(7 \times 5) - 4  \ \boxed{\phantom{=}} \  7 \times (5 - 4)$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Left side}  &= (7 \times 5) - 4 \\\\
                    &= 35 - 4 \\\\
                    &= 31 \\\\
\text{Right side} &= 7 \times (5 - 4) \\\\
                    &= 7 \times 1 \\\\
                    &= 7
\end{aligned}
$

How many numbers can he make that are bigger than $7000?$

**Working**

For a four-digit number to be bigger than $7000$, the first digit (the thousands digit) must be $7$.

Using permutation for the hundreds, tens and ones places:

Number of digits that can be used in the hundreds place $= 3$

Number of digits that can be used in the tens place $= 2$

Number of digits that can be used in the ones place $= 1$

Count $= 3 \times 2 \times 1 = 6$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of these fractions are greater than one half?

- $\dfrac{3}{5}$

- $\dfrac{3}{7}$ 

- $\dfrac{5}{12}$ 

- $\dfrac{8}{15}$ 

- $\dfrac{11}{20}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which of these fractions are greater than one half?
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{3}{5}$
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{3}{7}$ 
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{5}{12}$ 
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{8}{15}$ 
<emptyline>
- $\dfrac{11}{20}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

A fraction will be bigger than $\dfrac{1}{2}$ if twice of its numerator is bigger than the denominator.

Lets calculate for each fraction:

|   **Fraction**   | **$2n$** | **Compare** | **$> \tfrac12$?** |
| :--------------: | :------: | :---------: | :---------------: |
|  $\dfrac{3}{5}$  |    $6$   |   $6 > 5$   |      Yes     |
|  $\dfrac{3}{7}$  |    $6$   |   $6 > 7$   |         No        |
|  $\dfrac{5}{12}$ |   $10$   |  $10 > 12$  |         No        |
|  $\dfrac{8}{15}$ |   $16$   |  $16 > 15$  |     Yes      |
| $\dfrac{11}{20}$ |   $22$   |  $22 > 20$  |     Yes      |

Answer $= \dfrac{3}{5}, \dfrac{8}{15}, \dfrac{11}{20} $
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$ \dfrac{3}{5}, \dfrac{8}{15}, \dfrac{11}{20} $

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$a * b$ means multiply the two numbers together and then subtract the larger.

So:

$
\begin{aligned}
4 * 6 &= 24 - 6 \\\\
          &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

Find the value of $8 * 3$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$a * b$ means multiply the two numbers together and then subtract the larger.
<emptyline>
So:
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
4 * 6 &= 24 - 6 \\\\
          &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Find the value of $8 * 3$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 8 * 3 \\\\
&= (8 \times 3) - 8 \\\\
&= 24 - 8 \\\\
&= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

To convert kilometers to miles I multiply by $5$ and then divide by $8$.

Using this method how many miles is $240 \ \text{kilometers}$?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">To convert kilometers to miles I multiply by $5$ and then divide by $8$.
<emptyline>
Using this method how many miles is $240 \ \text{kilometers}$?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&=  240 \ \text {kilometers} \\\\
&=  (240 \times 5) \div 8 \ \text {miles} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {240 \times 5} {8} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {8 \times 30 \times 5} {8} \\\\
&=  \dfrac {\cancel {8} \times 30 \times 5} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
&=  30 \times 5 \\\\
&=  150 \ \text {miles}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$150 \ \text {miles}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of these lengths is longest?

$42\ \text{cm} \quad  0.4 \ \text{m} \quad  147 \ \text{mm} \quad  0.351 \ \text{m} \quad  33 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which of these lengths is longest?
<emptyline>
$42\ \text{cm} \quad  0.4 \ \text{m} \quad  147 \ \text{mm} \quad  0.351 \ \text{m} \quad  33 \ \text{cm}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's convert all the units to cm. 

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 42 \ \text{cm}, \quad 0.4 \ \text{m}, \quad 147 \ \text{mm}, \quad 0.351 \ \text{m}, \quad 33  \ \text{cm} \\\\
&= 42 \ \text{cm}, \quad 0.4 \times 100 \ \text{cm}, \quad \dfrac {147} {10} \ \text{cm}, \quad 0.351 \times 100 \ \text{cm}, \quad 33  \ \text{cm} \\\\
&= 42 \ \text{cm}, \quad 40 \ \text{cm}, \quad 14.7 \ \text{cm}, \quad 35.1 \ \text{cm}, \quad 33  \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Longest length $= 42 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$42 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $36 \div (9 + 3)?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $36 \div (9 + 3)?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= 36 \div (9 + 3) \\\\
&= \dfrac {36} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {12 \times 3} {12} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 3} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
&= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $432.6 \times 7 = 3028.2$

What is $43.26 \times 0.7 ?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {3028.2}{100} \\\\
&= 30.282
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate how much bigger is $3\dfrac{1}{4}$ is than $1\dfrac{3}{4}$ writing your answer as a decimal.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate how much bigger is $3\dfrac{1}{4}$ is than $1\dfrac{3}{4}$ writing your answer as a decimal.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 3 \dfrac {1} {4} - 1 \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {13} {4} - \dfrac {7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {13 - 7} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {6} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 2} {2 \times 2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {2}} {2 \times \cancel {2}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {2} \\\\
&= 1.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$1.5$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract $7 + (3 \times 11)$ from $(7 + 3) \times 11$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract $7 + (3 \times 11)$ from $(7 + 3) \times 11$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \big( (7 + 3) \times 11 \big) - \big( (7 + (3 \times 11)) \big) \\\\
&= (10 \times 11) - (7 + 33) \\\\
&= 110 - 40 \\\\
&= 70
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$70$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_bidmas
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
&= \big( (7 + 3) \times 11 \big) - \big( (7 + (3 \times 11)) \big) \\\\
&= (10 \times 11) - (7 + 33) \\\\
&= 110 - 40 \\\\
&= 70
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

&= 0.35 + 0.6 - 0.25 \\\\
&= 0.95 - 0.25 \\\\
&= 0.7
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract $4 + (2 \times 13)$ from $(4 + 2) \times 13$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract $4 + (2 \times 13)$ from $(4 + 2) \times 13$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \big( (4 + 2) \times 13 \big) - \big( 4 + (2 \times 13) \big) \\\\
&= (6 \times 13) - (4 + 26) \\\\
&= 78 - 30 \\\\
&= 48
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write down a fraction whose numerator and denominator are both whole
numbers and whose value is between $\dfrac{7}{13}$ and $\dfrac{8}{13}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {15} {26} 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract $20 + (1 \times 7)$ from $(20 + 1) \times 7$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract $20 + (1 \times 7)$ from $(20 + 1) \times 7$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= \big( (20 + 1) \times 7 \big) - \big( 20 + (1 \times 7) \big) \\\\
&= (21 \times 7) - (20 + 7) \\\\
&= 147 - 27 \\\\
&= 120
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $0.35 + \dfrac{4}{5} + \dfrac{37}{100}$, leaving your answer as a decimal. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $0.35 + \dfrac{4}{5} + \dfrac{37}{100}$, leaving your answer as a decimal. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 0.35 + \dfrac {4} {5} + \dfrac {37} {100} \\\\
&= 0.35 + \dfrac {4 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {37} {100} \\\\
&= 0.35+ \dfrac {8} {10} + \dfrac {37} {100} \\\\
&= 0.35 + 0.8 + 0.37 \\\\
&= 1.52
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

Write $\dfrac{21}{70}$ as a decimal. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write $\dfrac{21}{70}$ as a decimal. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {21} {70} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 7} {10 \times 7} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {7}} {10 \times \cancel {7}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {10} \\\\
&= 0.3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
21 - (a \times 3) &= 9 \\\\
21 - 3a           &= 9 \\\\
3a                &= 21-9 \\\\
3a                &= 12 \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac {12} {3} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac{4 \times 3}{3} \\\\
a                 &= \dfrac{4 \times \cancel 3}{\cancel 3} \\\\
a                 &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}

&= \dfrac {17 \times 3} {20 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17 \times \cancel {3}} {20 \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17} {20} \\\\
&= \dfrac {17 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {85} {100} \\\\
&= 0.85
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

What is the answer when the first prime number is subtracted from the first even multiple of $7?$

-  $5$
-  $11$
-  $12$
-  $13$ 

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $(999 - 99 + 9) \div 9?$

- $99$
- $100$
- $101$
- $109$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $(999 - 99 + 9) \div 9?$
<emptyline>
- $99$
- $100$
- $101$
- $109$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (999 - 99 + 9) \div 9 \\\\
&= (900 + 9) \div 9 \\\\
&= \dfrac {909} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {9 \times 101} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{9} \times 101} {\cancel{9}} \\\\
&= 101
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the value of $19 + 99 + 19 \times 99?$

- $1999$
- $11701$
- $13563$
- None of these 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

- $11701$
- $13563$
- None of these 
</code></pre>

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What number is halfway between $-3$ and $8?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What number is halfway between $-3$ and $8?$ 
</code></pre>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (-3 + 8) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 5\\\\
&= \dfrac {5} {2} \\\\
&= 2.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is halfway between $120$ and $300?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is halfway between $120$ and $300?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Working**

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (120 + 300) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 420\\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 210} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 210} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 210
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

How many thousands are there in one million?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Arrange the digits $7, 6, 5,$ and $4$ so that the resulting number is closest to five thousand.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Arrange the digits $7, 6, 5,$ and $4$ so that the resulting number is closest to five thousand.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To be close to $5000$, the number should start with $4$ (approaching from below) or $5$ (approaching from above).

For the number closest to $5000$ starting with $4$, we want the largest possible value, so $4765$. The difference is $5000 - 4765 = 235$.

For the number closest to $5000$ starting with $5$, we want the smallest possible value, so $5467$. The difference is $5467 - 5000 = 467$.

$235$ is smaller than $467$, so $4765$ is the nearest.

Answer $= 4765$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4765$

</div>
</div>
